rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for joining fabric with a needle and thread.

example.english: The shirt tore, so I used a needle to sew it back up myself.
example.traditional: 件衫爛咗，我自己用針縫返好。
example.jyutping: gin6 saam1 laan6 zo2 ngo5 zi6 gei2 jung6 zam1 fung4 faan1 hou2

rows.note: Use this when something is enclosed inside another object by sewing it in.

example.english: I’ll sew the name tag into the inner pocket of the coat.
example.traditional: 我將個名牌縫入件褸嘅內袋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 go3 meng4 paai4 fung4 jap6 gin6 lau1 ge3 noi6 doi6
